page: Microsoft Azure D8nds_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the Dndv6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

For local storage requirements, the D8nds_v6 instance includes a bundled 472 GB NVMe SSD. This local disk configuration is supplemented by Premium Storage capability, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The instance is designated as network-optimized within its family, though it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There is no GPU hardware allocated to this instance type.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D8nds_v6 offers a balanced hardware profile that pairs dedicated compute resources with local NVMe storage, reducing the need for external disk allocations for temporary data. This resource density makes the instance type suitable for workloads such as database hosting, network-intensive applications, general-purpose web serving, and mid-sized application backends requiring fast local scratch space.
